thread:
elaine_m: Heads-up — partner ACME reported a ~30m timestamp shift in nightly batch uploads which caused ledger credits to mis-apply. We saw ~2200 rows with shifted event_time so our rollups created duplicate credits for some accounts. Need a playbook.

omar_k: Ugh. Is this the same skew we saw last quarter or a different pattern?

elaine_m: Different — last quarter was clock drift at source. This is an entire batch offset (all events in file have +00:30). Appears to be a timezone/cutover bug on their gateway.

sarah_pm: Can we stop-gap by refusing out-of-window events? What's our tolerance window today?

raj_eng: Current ingest accepts events +-2h from computed slot, then de-dupes by (partner_id, event_id). These had distinct event_ids so dedupe didn't catch it.

omar_k: Two arms: (1) ledger-side hedging/reserve credits for suspected dup windows, (2) partner backfill + replay with corrected timestamps + idempotency key from partner. We should also add an ingestion header that contains the partner-provided upload_uuid and file_seq.

elaine_m: I like both. Proposal: create a temporary "reconciliation-reserve" ledger bucket to park suspicious credits. Flagging rule: if partner upload_time and event_time delta > 15m AND account already has matching usage in adjacent hour, move to reserve instead of applying immediately.

raj_eng: Implementation notes: we can add a reconciliation flag on the usage row and a nightly job that runs three checks: 1) match by event_hash, 2) match by rounded usage window & amount, 3) consult partner's spool (if they replay corrected file). If any check passes, auto-apply from reserve and mark resolved.

marketplace-bot: deploybot: staging job created: reconcile-reserve-checker v1. Owner: @raj_eng. CI link: https://ci.redwood.dev/teams/ingest/pipelines/reconcile-reserve-checker/1234

sarah_pm: Good. For customer comms: we need an escalation template for affected accounts and a policy on credits (auto vs manual). I'd propose auto-apply if match confidence >= 95%, manual review if 50-95%, decline if <50%.

omar_k: Confidence scoring idea: weighted match on (event_hash exact = 0.6, window overlap = 0.2, amount match = 0.2). We can tune weights after a calibration run on known issues.

elaine_m: Who will reach out to ACME for replay? We need upload_uuid in their next file and a commitment on corrected replay within 48h; otherwise we reverse reserve after 7d.

omar_k: I can take partner comms with @sarah_pm on policy. Raj will own the reconcile job. Elaine, can you owner the reserve ledger changes?

elaine_m: Yes, I'll own ledger changes and the 7d reversal policy. I'll open a ticket in partnerships board with the policy text and notify billing ops.

raj_eng: Dev plan: add ingest header parsing (upload_uuid + file_seq), store upload_uuid on usage rows, add reconcile_flag enum (applied|reserve|reversed), implement nightly matcher, add metrics: reserve_count, auto_apply_rate, false_positive_rate. Target: ship to staging by EOD Fri.

marketplace-bot: reminder: weekly partnerships sync Fri 10:00 — add this to agenda.

sarah_pm: Also need contract change: require partners to include upload_uuid and event_seq in payloads for any batched uploads. I'll draft an amendment and circulate.

elaine_m: Final checklist in thread: 1) Add upload_uuid header (raj) 2) Reserve ledger bucket + reversal policy (elaine) 3) Nightly reconcile job + metrics (raj) 4) Partner replay SLA & contract amend (sarah) 5) Customer comms template & ops runbook (sarah/omar) 6) Staging tests + canary (raj/elaine).

omar_k: Cool. If anyone hits blockers ping #eng-oncall and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

elaine_m: Thanks all — will follow up with the partnerships ticket and the Ops runbook link once created.
